description: Which trend-chart filters the analyst named, from a free-text display request.

lookback_days.description: Relative lookback in days, e.g. 7 for 'last 7 days'. Null when the analyst gave an explicit date range instead, or named no date filter at all (then the default of 14 days is used).
lookback_days.title: Lookback Days

start_date.description: Explicit ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) range start, only when the analyst named an explicit date range (e.g. 'from 12-02-2025 to 12-02-2026') instead of a relative lookback. Null otherwise.
start_date.title: Start Date

end_date.description: Explicit ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) range end, paired with start_date. Null otherwise.
end_date.title: End Date

lot_ids.description: Lot IDs named by the analyst (e.g. 'lot1, lot2, lot3'). Empty list means all lots.
lot_ids.title: Lot Ids

product_ids.description: Product IDs named by the analyst. Empty list means all products.
product_ids.title: Product Ids

layer_ids.description: Layer IDs named by the analyst. Empty list means all layers.
layer_ids.title: Layer Ids

exposure_equipment_ids.description: Exposure equipment (machine) IDs named by the analyst. Empty list means all machines.
exposure_equipment_ids.title: Exposure Equipment Ids

interpretation.description: One short sentence stating which filters were applied, or that defaults were used.
interpretation.title: Interpretation

title: TrendFilters
